sections.heading: Passport Seva document upload guidelines.
body: The Passport Seva Portal (passportindia.gov.in) accepts supporting documents in PDF format up to 1 MB per file.
However, slow government server connection speeds mean files over 500 KB frequently cause upload timeout errors. Compressing your PDF down to 200–500 KB ensures fast, glitch-free submission.

faq.q: What is the maximum file size for Passport Seva document uploads?
faq.a: Supporting documents uploaded to Passport Seva must be PDF format under 1 MB. Staying between 200 KB and 500 KB is highly recommended to avoid server timeout issues.
